rules.text: Holiday purchases made beginning November 2, 2026 will be eligible for return or exchange through January 24, 2027.

rules.text: You can return items that are unused and in original condition within 30 days of purchase with your original receipt or electronic receipt.

rules.text: Original receipt or electronic receipt is required for returns.

rules.text: Returned items must include all original stones and components to be eligible for a refund.
rules.quote: To be eligible for a refund, returned items, must include all original stones and components.

rules.text: Pandora may deny a return or refund if the item has been altered, modified, damaged, tampered with, or had any stone or component removed, substituted, or replaced after purchase.

rules.text: Return shipping is free for returns by mail.
rules.quote: Return shipping is on us, so you won't be charged.

rules.text: Original shipping charges are not refundable.

rules.text: Gift Cards are non-returnable and not refundable once purchased.

rules.text: To exchange, first return the original item for a refund, then purchase the new item; in-store exchanges for equal or lesser value items may be available depending on inventory.
rules.quote:
If you’d like a different item:

*   First, return the original item and receive a refund
    
*   Then, purchase your new item
    
*   In-store exchanges for items of equal or lesser value may be available, depending on store inventory
